title: festuca ovina var. arizonica
intro: Festuca ovina var. arizonica, commonly known as Arizona fescue, is a type of grass native to the southwestern United States. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Arizona fescue include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, reducing inflammation, and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Arizona fescue may also include antimicrobial and antifungal properties, making it a potential candidate for further research into its medicinal applications.
